votes.refutation: I checked the premise that a fresh sync necessarily makes a repository ready. New sync rows are deliberately enabled=False (presentation/views.py:312-315), so a false result in that common case is correct. The remaining supported case is an already-enabled config being bound or a newly synced config subsequently enabled, followed by a read before replica catch-up. The frontend keeps an already-on toggle interactive, and the actual worker pins its eligibility query to the writer (tasks/tasks.py:1136-1146). The proven impact is a transient opt-in obstruction recoverable by reloading, not failed approvals; severity is consider.
